description: This file defines the interface for a security daemon management module, including data structures, function prototypes, and callback handlers for controlling security daemon processes within a network management context.

classes.name: wld_secDmn
classes.description: Structure representing a security daemon instance, including control interfaces, process management, configuration, and event handlers.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_init
methods.description: Initializes a security daemon instance with command, arguments, configuration file, and interface directory.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_setEvtHandlers
methods.description: Sets event handlers for security daemon lifecycle events.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up and releases resources associated with a security daemon instance.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_start
methods.description: Starts the security daemon process.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_stop
methods.description: Stops the security daemon process.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_reload
methods.description: Reloads the security daemon configuration.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_setArgs
methods.description: Sets startup arguments for the security daemon.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_restartCb
methods.description: Callback invoked to handle security daemon restart.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_restart
methods.description: Restarts the security daemon process.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_setRestartNeeded
methods.description: Flags the daemon process to require a restart.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_checkRestartNeeded
methods.description: Checks if a restart is needed for the daemon process.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_isRestarting
methods.description: Returns whether the daemon is currently restarting.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_isRunning
methods.description: Checks if the daemon process is running.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the security daemon is enabled.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_isAlive
methods.description: Checks if the daemon process is alive.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_hasAvailableCtrlIface
methods.description: Verifies if a control interface is available.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_hasGlobalCtrlIface
methods.description: Verifies if a global control interface exists.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_hasReadyGlobalCtrlIface
methods.description: Checks if the global control interface is ready.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_getGlobalCtrlIface
methods.description: Retrieves the global control interface.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_getWpaCtrlMgr
methods.description: Gets the WPA control manager associated with the daemon.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_setCfgParamSupp
methods.description: Sets support status for a configuration parameter.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_getCfgParamSupp
methods.description: Gets support status for a configuration parameter.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_getCfgParamsListBySuppVal
methods.description: Retrieves list of configuration parameters by support value.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_countCfgParamSuppAll
methods.description: Counts all supported configuration parameters.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_countCfgParamSuppChecked
methods.description: Counts checked supported configuration parameters.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_countCfgParamSuppByVal
methods.description: Counts configuration parameters by support value.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_detectCfgParamsSupp
methods.description: Detects support for configuration parameters.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_getCtrlIfaceDirPath
methods.description: Gets the control interface directory path.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_setCmdSupp
methods.description: Sets support status for a command.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_getCmdSupp
methods.description: Gets support status for a command.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_learnCmdSuppFromHelpMsg
methods.description: Learns command support from help message.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_deduceCmdSuppFromExecRc
methods.description: Deduces command support from execution return code.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_addToGrp
methods.description: Adds the daemon to a group.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_delFromGrp
methods.description: Removes the daemon from its group.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_getGrp
methods.description: Retrieves the group the daemon belongs to.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_isGrpMember
methods.description: Checks if the daemon is a group member.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_countGrpMembers
methods.description: Counts total group members.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_countActiveGrpMembers
methods.description: Counts active group members.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_isActiveAlone
methods.description: Checks if the daemon is active alone.

methods.name: wld_secDmn_isGrpRestarting
methods.description: Checks if the group is restarting.
